color-primary.usage: Primary brand colour — key actions, active states, links.

color-primary-dark.usage: Darker primary — button text-on-fill and hover/pressed states (AA).

color-secondary.usage: Secondary/accent — supporting highlights and secondary actions.

color-success.usage: Success status — confirmations, positive badges (with an icon/label).

color-error.usage: Error status — validation errors, destructive actions.

color-ink.usage: Primary text / headings on light surfaces.

color-border.usage: Borders, dividers, input outlines (AA 3:1 vs canvas).

color-primary-subtle.usage: Low-emphasis primary tint — selected states, focus rings, badge backgrounds.

color-secondary-subtle.usage: Low-emphasis secondary tint — promo banners, highlight chips.

color-success-subtle.usage: Success background tint — inline success alerts.

color-warning-subtle.usage: Warning background tint — inline caution alerts.

color-error-subtle.usage: Error background tint — inline validation error alerts.

color-focus-ring.usage: Keyboard focus outline colour — maps to color-primary for consistency.

color-on-primary.usage: Text / icon colour rendered on top of color-primary fill.

color-on-secondary.usage: Text / icon colour rendered on top of color-secondary fill.

color-link.usage: Hyperlink default colour — maps to color-primary.

color-link-hover.usage: Hyperlink hover/visited colour — maps to color-primary-dark.

space-3.usage: Control padding — input vertical inset, small button padding.

space-4.usage: Default element spacing — paragraph gap, list item gap.

space-5.usage: Medium spacing — between stacked form fields.

space-6.usage: Card padding — group spacing, panel insets.

space-10.usage: Large section spacing — hero vertical padding.

space-16.usage: Page-level vertical rhythm — top/bottom page padding on desktop.

touch-target.usage: Minimum width and height for all interactive controls (WCAG 2.5.5).

content-max-width.usage: Maximum width of the main content column for readability.

prose-max-width.usage: Maximum line length for long-form body text.

radius-none.usage: No rounding — full-bleed images, table cells.

radius-full.usage: Pill badges, avatar circles, toggle tracks.

family-sans.usage: Primary UI typeface — all headings, body, and labels.

family-mono.usage: Code snippets, SKU / order ID display, promo codes.

size-xs.usage: Caption / helper text — maps to type-caption.

size-sm.usage: Secondary / metadata text — maps to type-small.

size-base.usage: Default body text — maps to type-body / type-h3.

size-xl.usage: Page / hero title — maps to type-display.

line-height-tight.usage: Display and hero headings where compact vertical rhythm is preferred.

line-height-snug.usage: Large headings — maps to type-h1 (32px line on 24px size).

line-height-normal.usage: Body text, small text, captions — comfortable reading rhythm.

line-height-relaxed.usage: Long-form prose sections requiring extra breathing room.

weight-regular.usage: Body, small, caption — type-body, type-small, type-caption.

weight-medium.usage: Emphasized labels, nav items, table headers.

weight-semibold.usage: Sub-section and card headings — type-h2, type-h3.

weight-bold.usage: Page and section headings — type-display, type-h1.

tracking-tight.usage: Display / hero titles — pulls large type together.

tracking-normal.usage: Body and UI text — no adjustment.

tracking-wide.usage: Uppercase labels, badge text, small caps.

type-label-uppercase.usage: Section eyebrows, badge text, status chip labels.

type-code.usage: Order IDs, SKU codes, promo codes, inline code.
